claim_boundary: This analysis isolates two components of RelCompat3D-Linear on the existing shared target. It does not establish dataset-level generalization or component necessity for the MLP estimator.

conditions.full_linear: BCE, relation-preserving augmentation, linked pairwise loss, and transformation averaging
conditions.no_pairwise_loss: the same Linear estimator without the linked pairwise term; relation-preserving augmentation and transformation averaging remain
conditions.no_transformation_averaging: the same fitted full Linear estimator scored directly without inference-time transformation averaging
